theoreticalCategories.description: Direct suggestion through voice, manner, appearance and eyes.
Supposed attraction resulting from persistent thought.

records.originalRussian: Мой же совѣтъ вамъ былъ бы по прочтеніи всѣхъ этихъ лекцій снова вернуться къ настоящей и тщательно пройти ее во второй разъ.
records.normalizedEnglish: After reading all lessons, return and carefully read Lesson IV a second time.

repetitions.details: A second reading of Lesson IV after the course, not an exercise repetition schedule.

prerequisites: Read all lessons before the proposed second reading of Lesson IV.

records.originalRussian: Если же читатель пожелалъ бы ознакомиться полнѣе съ этимъ предметомъ, то я посовѣтывалъ бы ему прочитать какой-нибудь хорошій трудъ по гипнотизму и гипнотическому внушенію.
records.normalizedEnglish: For further understanding the author suggests a good work on hypnotism/hypnotic suggestion, without naming one.

records.originalRussian: Такъ, запомните же эту вышеочерченную воображаемую картину двухъ функцій или проявленій ума въ лицѣ какъ бы двухъ участниковъ-братьевъ съ активнымъ и пассивнымъ характеромъ.
records.normalizedEnglish: Imagine and remember two business partners representing active and passive mental functions; a conceptual analogy, not a standalone timed exercise.

records.originalRussian: отсюда слѣдуетъ и найти эту слабую точку его и повести прямо на нее атаку.
records.normalizedEnglish: The author advises finding a weak point and directing an attack there; surrounding strategies aim to bypass vigilance.
records.exclusionReason: Conflicts with consent and respect for refusal. Documentary preservation only; no guided equivalent is attributed to the author.

records.originalRussian: Никогда слово «нѣтъ» не принимайте за отвѣтъ.
records.normalizedEnglish: Never accept no as an answer; preserved as historical instruction, excluded from guided publication.
records.exclusionReason: Conflicts with consent and respect for refusal. Documentary preservation only; no guided equivalent is attributed to the author.

records.originalRussian: Внушенія пріобрѣтаютъ себѣ силу путемъ повторенія.
records.normalizedEnglish: The author claims suggestions gain force through repetition and discusses delayed effects and another meeting; no numeric count or interval.

repetitions.details: Repeated suggestions/proposals; no quantified schedule. Refusal counts on PDF38 are not exercise repetitions.

records.originalRussian: Начните прежде съ легкихъ упражненій, но увѣренность должна быть съ самаго начала.
records.normalizedEnglish: Begin with easy exercises and confidence from the start; no actual exercise or advancement threshold is specified here.
